heads.en: Instead of following the season's brand-name package, New York Street is filming the unique souls, retrospects, '70s shirts', the taste of the sky, the price of the best, and the market is blowing a wave of anti-bones. The modern people who really know how to wear it, instead of blindly pursuing new foods from the season, they're stuck in the market. New York street mirrors are no longer just targeting supermodels on the stretcher, turning to capture the unique mix of souls on the roadside. The ancient shirts of the '70s, the retrospective robes of the '50s, '60s, went through a fine mix, and suddenly went beyond the classic form of time. The second hand has long since been a second-rate and second-rate preparation, rising to a new field of taste and investment. Eight minutes ago, the international community didn't follow the season's name pack!

新台幣貶破33元旅費縮水！預算5萬遊日本「少吃16碗拉麵」 新台幣兌美元匯率持續走弱，今（6）日盤中一度貶破33元大關、最低來到33.04元，創逾一年半新低，準備出國的民眾荷包也跟著縮水。以日本旅遊為例，若準備5萬元作為當地消費預算，與今年6月初相比，現在可兌換的日圓已減少約1.6萬日圓，相當於少吃約16碗拉麵，也少掉1張多的東京迪士尼門票，匯率變化對旅遊購買力的影響相當有感。 11 分鐘前｜生活 新台幣貶破33元旅費縮水！預算5萬遊日本「少吃16碗拉麵」 11 分鐘前｜生活
heads.en: The US dollar exchange rate for the new Taiwan dollar has continued to weaken for 50,000 journeys to Japan to "less than 16 bowls of ramen" – at a minimum of $33.04 a year and a half a year. heads.t: 禮讓問題爆衝突！北市男騎士「人行道」追撞單車 雙方慘遭警開罰 台北市一名機車騎士陳姓男子因禮讓問題與腳踏車騎士郭姓男子發生口角，5日晚上7時許在敦化北路、南京東路交叉口雙方爭執後，陳姓機車騎士因情緒激動，先是試圖追撞郭姓男子未果，隨後又在人行道上尾隨並再次追撞。警方到場後，依據《道路交通管理處罰條例》對兩人分別裁罰。 14 分鐘前｜社會 禮讓問題爆衝突！北市男騎士「人行道」追撞單車 雙方慘遭警開罰 14 分鐘前｜社會

heads.t: 敬酒敬到亮拳頭！桃園酒店深夜叫囂暴動 警對空轟4槍霸氣壓制 桃園市桃園區寶山街一間酒店今（6）日凌晨1時許發生酒客衝突，疑似2派人馬因敬酒問題爆發口角，之後互相找人助陣，現場叫囂聲不斷、場面一度混亂。桃園警方獲報後立即啟動快打部隊30多人到場，為控制衝突，員警現場對空鳴槍4發，隨後將滋事人員控制帶離，並依聚眾鬥毆等罪嫌偵辦。 16 分鐘前｜社會 敬酒敬到亮拳頭！桃園酒店深夜叫囂暴動 警對空轟4槍霸氣壓制 16 分鐘前｜社會

heads.en: Undersea sounding alerts! 44% of the world's coral reef is in danger of extinction. Expert alerts: no natural, no economic, the blue ocean warms, and the coloured castles of the sea quietly lose their glory. The heat-pressure waves of global warming are forcing all-round safe havens to exist. The scientific journal Nature published an updated and comprehensive assessment of the extent to which up to 40 per cent of coral reef species are on the brink of extinction. It is not only the ripping of marine life chains, but also the severest blow to the global economy of tourists and fishers who depend on the coast for their livelihood. 8 minutes ago, the international sea floor was sounding! 44% of the world's coral reef is dying.
